tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: Which of the following pairs has both members from the same period of periodic table:

solution.text:
$_{11} \mathrm{Na} \Rightarrow 2,8,1 ;{ }_{17} \mathrm{Cl} \Rightarrow 2,8,7$
These have same number of shells. Hence, they are the elements of the same period.
